recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not re-add root populationBasis or Measure.basis for this issue; current Measure population basis is intentionally represented at Measure.group.basis, with basisRequirement available for more specific constraints.
issue_request: FHIR-24624 was Published/Persuasive and asked to add a populationBasis element to Measure, typed against all FHIR types, so the expected population case type would be explicit rather than inferred from population criteria expression result types.
initial_application: Commit df7089e33e47459fdadb4a0c8ef51721b3b7a6b7 applied the issue by adding root Measure.basis with the population-basis definition, code type, meaningWhenMissing boolean, and required all-types binding. Commit cb1a35e127db8b8ff8abfccfe2b7216a4a64b2ac then added Measure.group.basis as the group-level override surface.
additional_context: FHIR-32079 and FHIR-32194 later kept the all-FHIR-types binding semantics while documenting abstract type use and authoring-environment constraints; FHIR-32069 moved the binding to ValueSet/fhir-types. FHIR-49922 and FHIR-50664 later deprecated and removed root Measure calculation elements in favor of group-level calculation definition, and FHIR-50500 added Measure.group.basisRequirement for mixed or profiled population-basis requirements.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/fhir.ini includes Measure as an active resource, source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml contains Measure.group.basis with the required fhir-types binding and boolean default semantics, and root Measure.basis is intentionally absent after later R6 simplification work.
